detail.title: SA85DBHG | 8.5 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (Black & Orange)
detail.overview: The SA85DBHG 8.5 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine combines power, efficiency, and durability to make laundry effortless. Designed with an anti-corrosive rust-free body, it ensures long-lasting performance. The Roller Jet with Mini Pulsator and Dual Waterfall Technology provide deep cleaning, while the powerful motor delivers high-speed washing with minimal noise. With 3 wash programs, a Magic Filter for lint-free clothes, and a Hydraulic Wash Lid for easy handling, this washing machine is built for convenience. The Water Level Adjuster optimizes usage, and the Buzzer Alert notifies you when the cycle is complete. A perfect choice for modern households.
